data.long_meaning: In Basque culture, Maite is derived from the word ‘maitia’, meaning ‘mother’. In Christianity, the name is associated with the Virgin Mary and the divine motherhood. The name Maite carries the meaning “Mother of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Maite usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Μαïτη
in_greek.meaning: Το Μαïτη σημαίνει αγαπημένη στα Ελληνικά
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μαïτη δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα στην Καινή Διαθήκη, αλλά συνδέεται με την έννοια της αγάπης. Στην ελληνική γλώσσα, το όνομα αυτό μπορεί να συνδεθεί με τη λέξη 'αγάπη' και να συμβολίζει την αγάπη του Θεού ή την αγάπη μεταξύ των ανθρώπων.

data.cultural_impact: The name Maite has deep roots in Basque culture, as it is derived from the word ‘maitia’, meaning ‘mother’. This itself carries a profound cultural significance, as motherhood is highly revered in Basque society. The soft, melodic sound of the name Maite is pleasing to the ears and is often used as a term of endearment among friends and family. It is also a common name in Basque communities, reflecting the value placed on motherhood and family.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Maite takes on a deeper spiritual meaning as it is associated with the Virgin Mary and the divine motherhood. Mary is considered the ultimate maternal figure, having given birth to Jesus, the Son of God. The name Maite embodies the nurturing, loving, and compassionate qualities of Mary, making it a spiritually significant name for Christians. Additionally, the name is a reminder of the unconditional love and maternal care that God provides to all His children. With this in mind, carrying the name Maite is a constant reminder of the love and care originating from both maternal and divine sources.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Maite is a Basque name meaning "little mother" or "graceful one." In Christian tradition, it symbolizes the nurturing and loving qualities of the Virgin Mary, as well as the grace and beauty bestowed upon us by God.
